collection.description: A kind caregiver is distressed by a frightening thought they never wanted.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A kind caregiver is distressed by a frightening thought they never wanted and would never act on.

choices.label: Listen without treating thought as intent
Help them speak with a trusted healer
Offer a calm distraction by request

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They feel safe enough to discuss the worry.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The healer explains that unwanted thoughts can be upsetting and explores support.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They work together on a familiar task; the thought may still return.
